findings.example: does not raise and creates no row when no organization matches the customer
findings.title: Nil-org example is unfalsifiable: no mutation of the sanctioned insertion can make it fail, so it does not verify the `if organization` guard it exists to test
findings.detail: The example's only substantive assertion is `not_to change(SubscriptionEvent, :count)`. That assertion cannot fail under ANY implementation of SANCTIONED INSERTION 2: if the `if organization` guard is deleted, `organization.plan` in the CreateSubscriptionEvent.call kwarg list raises NoMethodError on nil BEFORE any write, the insertion's own `rescue StandardError` swallows and logs it, and the count is still unchanged -- the example passes. The implicit no-raise expectation is equally invariant: every StandardError in the branch is swallowed by the insertion's rescue and the branch's pre-existing outer rescue, so `perform_now` can never raise. Under mutation of the guard (the specific SPEC 5.3 behavior this example exists to pin -- 'The call runs only when organization is present ... a nil organization skips the ledger write entirely'), both assertions are invariant. This is the same class as r3-l1-a9-001 (ledger-failure example passed with the insertion's behavior broken), which this run series classifies HIGH. A falsifiable observable exists and is unasserted: with the guard deleted, the rescue logs 'Stripe subscription.deleted SubscriptionEvent ledger error: ...'; with the guard present and a nil organization, that log line never fires. Fix (same logger-spy pattern 549039a0c already added to the invoice.paid ledger-failure example, inverted): add `allow(Rails.logger).to receive(:error).and_call_original` before the perform and `expect(Rails.logger).not_to have_received(:error).with(/\AStripe subscription\.deleted SubscriptionEvent ledger error:/)` after, distinguishing a clean skip from a rescued NoMethodError.

verified: Insertion placement (SPEC 5.3 item 1): SANCTIONED INSERTION 2 is appended at the END of the customer.subscription.deleted else-branch (main branch) body at 549039a0c, immediately after `EngagementReport::GeneratorJob.perform_later(organization&.id, trigger: 'subscription_canceled')` and before the else's `end`, wrapped in its OWN `begin/rescue StandardError => e` that logs with context: Rails.logger.error "Stripe subscription.deleted SubscriptionEvent ledger error: org=#{organization&.id} subscription=#{stripe_subscription_id} msg=#{e.message}" plus `ap e`.

Writer call exact (SPEC 5.3 item 2): CreateSubscriptionEvent.call(organization: organization, event_type: 'canceled_subscription', to_plan: organization.plan, stripe_subscription_id: stripe_subscription_id) -- kwargs byte-match the spec; NO amount param. stripe_subscription_id is the pre-existing branch-local set from object.id at the top of the when-branch, in scope at the insertion.

Nil-org guard shape (SPEC 5.3 item 3): plain `if organization` conditional inside the rescue-wrapped block; nil skips the CreateSubscriptionEvent.call entirely. Nothing else in the branch changed: `git diff a0d59115d..549039a0c -- app/jobs/stripe_webhook_handler_job.rb` is exactly two purely-additive hunks, 34 insertions, 0 deletions; the subscription.deleted hunk contains only the sanctioned block. Full branch read at 549039a0c: credit-pack branch, `organization&.sync_with_stripe if stripe_subscription_id == organization&.stripe_subscription_id`, `organization&.update_column(:subscription_canceled_at, ...)`, both perform_later lines, and the outer rescue are byte-identical to a0d59115d. D11 delicacy audit for this slice: PASS (no unsanctioned change anywhere in the file; the second hunk is SANCTIONED INSERTION 1, other agents' slice).

Interactor guard-order backstop (SPEC 6, slice item 4): in create_subscription_event.rb at 549039a0c, `return unless organization` now executes immediately after `organization = context.organization`, BEFORE the two ap lines ('Stripe subscription in good standing?' / `ap organization.stripe_subscription_in_good_standing`), so any caller passing organization: nil no-ops gracefully instead of raising NoMethodError. Also confirmed SubscriptionEvent::CONVERSION_EVENT_TYPES = %w[converted_to_paid trial_converted_to_paid] excludes canceled_subscription, so the conversion-uniqueness guard correctly does not constrain the cancellation writer (5-minute dedupe only, per SPEC 5.3).

Positive test (SPEC 9.1): 'creates a canceled_subscription row and keeps the existing branch behavior intact' asserts SubscriptionEvent count +1; event_type == 'canceled_subscription'; stripe_subscription_id == organization.stripe_subscription_id; to_plan == organization.plan; have_enqueued_job(Notification::PaidSubscriptionDeletedJob).with(organization.id, subscription_ended_at); have_enqueued_job(EngagementReport::GeneratorJob).with(organization.id, trigger: 'subscription_canceled'); organization.reload.subscription_canceled_at present; have_received(:sync_with_stripe). Queue-adapter :test around-block present (pipeline rule 31). Non-vacuous: deleting the insertion fails the count/attribute assertions; the sync_with_stripe spy is on the exact instance returned by the stubbed Organization.find_by, and the fixture's stripe_subscription_id genuinely satisfies the branch's equality condition (create_credit_test_organization sets stripe_customer_id/stripe_subscription_id; build_deleted_subscription reuses them).

Test routing traced: the event double survives log_stripe_changes (`return unless event.data.respond_to?(:previous_attributes)` bails on the data double -- guard is pre-existing, not part of this diff), and 'plan_ats_tier_starter_v2_monthly' has no AI_CREDIT_AMOUNTS_BY_LOOKUP_KEY entry (built from Variables::AI_CREDIT_ALLOCATIONS keys), so ai_credit_subscription_plan_lookup_key? is false and the main (else) branch executes.

549039a0c fix audit (slice item 5, last clause): `git show 549039a0c` is 7 added lines, 0 deletions, spec file only -- all inside the two invoice.paid examples ('creates exactly one row across duplicate deliveries...' gains the created_at backdate; the ledger-failure example gains the logger spy and have_received(:call)/logger assertions). The two customer.subscription.deleted examples are byte-untouched by 549039a0c -- their assertions were not weakened. Also confirmed 7574df408 is spec-file-only (3 insertions), so the app diff is unchanged since 89286fba8 as stated.

Execution lineage: the two subscription.deleted examples at 549039a0c are byte-identical to their state at e850c74fe, where run-3 agent-3 ran them live (2 examples, 0 failures, interactor + after_commit fan-out observed).
